cards.ex: Feel free to chime in if you have any ideas.
cards.exUz: Agar sizda biron bir fikr bo'lsa, qo'shilishdan tortinmang.
cards.uzDef: Suhbatga qo'shilib, o'z fikrini bildirish, ayniqsa rozi bo'lganda.

cards.ex: "I think we should postpone the meeting." "I second that."
cards.exUz: "Menimcha, uchrashuvni keyinga qoldirishimiz kerak." "Men ham qo'shilaman."
cards.uzDef: Birovning fikrini to'liq qo'llab-quvvatlash, rozilikni bildirish.

cards.ex: We had a difference of opinion about the budget, but we worked it out.
cards.exUz: Byudjet bo'yicha fikrlar farqi bor edi, lekin biz buni hal qildik.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlar o'rtasida kelishmovchilik, bahs bo'lishi.

cards.ex: She decided to take a stand against the new policy.
cards.exUz: U yangi siyosatga qarshi pozitsiyani egallashga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir narsaga qarshi yoki tarafdor bo'lish, qat'iy pozitsiyani bildirish.

cards.ex: On that score, I have to agree with you.
cards.exUz: Shu nuqtai nazardan, men sizga qo'shilishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Shu masalada, shu jihatdan degan ma'noni bildiradi.

cards.ex: They're poles apart on almost every political issue.
cards.exUz: Ular deyarli har bir siyosiy masalada qarama-qarshi.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlar, qarashlar butunlay bir-biriga zid bo'lishi.

cards.ex: That's a fair point; I hadn't thought of it that way.
cards.exUz: Bu o'rinli fikr; Men bu haqda o'ylamagan edim.
cards.uzDef: Mantiqiy, asosli fikr, rozi bo'lishga arziydi.

cards.ex: Even though everyone disagreed, she stuck to her guns.
cards.exUz: Hamma rozi bo'lmasa ham, u o'z fikrida qoldi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini qat'iy himoya qilish, o'zgartirmaslik.

cards.ex: "Are you coming to the party?" "I'm afraid not."
cards.exUz: "Siz ziyofatga kelyapsizmi?" "Afsuski, yo'q."
cards.uzDef: Rad etishning muloyim shakli, rozilik yo'qligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: I have to take issue with your claim that our sales are down.
cards.exUz: Sizning savdo pasaygan degan da'voyingizga e'tiroz bildiraman.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir fikrga yoki bayonotga qarshi chiqish, e'tiroz bildirish.

cards.ex: I'm with you there; the first half of the movie was amazing.
cards.exUz: Shu yerda sizga qo'shilaman; filmining birinchi qismi ajoyib edi.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir fikrga qisman rozi bo'lishni bildiradi.

cards.ex: We agree in principle, but we still need to discuss the details.
cards.exUz: Biz asosan rozi bo'ldik, lekin tafsilotlarni muhokama qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Umumiy g'oyaga rozi bo'lish, lekin tafsilotlar haqida emas.

cards.ex: You have a point; we should consider all the options.
cards.exUz: Sizning gapingizda jon bor; biz barcha variantlarni ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Birovning fikri mantiqiy va asosli ekanligini tan olish.

cards.ex: "Do you think he'll win?" "Not by a long shot!"
cards.exUz: "U g'alaba qozonadi deb o'ylaysizmi?" "Mutlaqo emas!"
cards.uzDef: Mutlaqo rozi emaslikni, umuman teskari fikrda ekanlikni bildiradi.

cards.ex: There was a clash of opinions during the meeting about the new strategy.
cards.exUz: Yangi strategiya bo'yicha yig'ilishda fikrlar to'qnashuvi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlar o'rtasida jiddiy kelishmovchilik, bahs-munozara yuzaga kelishi.

cards.ex: She stood firm against the pressure to change her mind.
cards.exUz: U fikrini o'zgartirish bosimiga qarshi qattiq turdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini qat'iy ushlab turish, o'zgartirmaslik.

cards.ex: I couldn't disagree more with your assessment of the situation.
cards.exUz: Sizning vaziyatni baholashingizga qat'iyan rozi emasman.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay qarshi fikrda bo'lish, rozi bo'lmaslikning eng kuchli ifodasi.

cards.ex: With all due respect, I beg to differ.
cards.exUz: Hurmat bilan aytaman, men e'tiroz bildiraman.
cards.uzDef: Muloyimlik bilan rozi emaslikni ifodalash.

cards.ex: I have to take issue with your claim that the project is over budget.
cards.exUz: Loyiha byudjetdan oshib ketgan degan da'voyingizga qarshi chiqishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir fikrga yoki narsaga rozi bo'lmaslik, e'tiroz bildirish.

cards.ex: We're on the same wavelength when it comes to design.
cards.exUz: Dizayn haqida gap ketganda, biz bir to'lqinda bo'lamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrlash, bir-birini yaxshi tushunish.

cards.ex: Everyone should have their say before we make a decision.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin har kim o'z fikrini bildirishga haqli.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini erkin va to'liq bildirish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: We are in broad agreement on the main points of the proposal.
cards.exUz: Biz taklifning asosiy nuqtalari bo'yicha umumiy kelishuvga erishdik.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy masalalarda rozi bo'lish, lekin tafsilotlarda emas.

cards.ex: The negotiation ended in a meeting of minds and a successful agreement.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar o'zaro tushunish va muvaffaqiyatli kelishuv bilan yakunlandi.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro tushunish va kelishuvga erishish.

cards.ex: Our shared understanding of the problem is a good point of departure.
cards.exUz: Muammoni birgalikda tushunishimiz yaxshi boshlang'ich nuqta.
cards.uzDef: Bahs yoki muzokaralar boshlanadigan nuqta.

cards.ex: I support the plan, but with reservations about the cost.
cards.exUz: Men rejani qo'llab-quvvatlayman, lekin xarajatlar bo'yicha shubhalarim bor.
cards.uzDef: To'liq rozi bo'lmaslik, shubhalar mavjudligini bildirish.

cards.ex: We just see things differently when it comes to raising children.
cards.exUz: Biz bolalarni tarbiyalash masalasida shunchaki boshqacha fikrlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsaga boshqacha nuqtai nazardan qarash, fikrlar mos kelmasligi.

cards.ex: The council and local residents are at loggerheads over the new development.
cards.exUz: Kengash va mahalliy aholi yangi qurilish bo'yicha kelishmovchilikda.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy kelishmovchilikda bo'lish, murosaga kelolmaslik.

cards.ex: The company is a house divided, and it's affecting productivity.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya bo'linib ketgan uy, va bu unumdorlikka ta'sir qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ichki kelishmovchiliklar tufayli zaiflashgan guruh yoki tashkilot.

cards.ex: His proposal for a four-day week was a non-starter with management.
cards.exUz: Uning to'rt kunlik ish haftasi haqidagi taklifi rahbariyat uchun qabul qilinmadi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilinishi yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishishi mumkin bo'lmagan taklif yoki g'oya.

cards.ex: I wholeheartedly agree with everything you've said.
cards.exUz: Men siz aytgan har bir narsaga chin dildan qo'shilaman.
cards.uzDef: To'liq va ishonch bilan rozi bo'lish.
